My research focuses broadly on natural resource economics, energy,

## Fisheries & Natural Resource Institutions

### Property Rights and Participation in Alaska Commercial Fisheries

This project examines how the creation and transfer of commercial
fishing rights affect participation over time.

## Energy & Resource Economics

### Alaska LNG and Pacific Natural Gas Markets

Research examining the competitiveness of Alaska LNG under uncertainty
about construction costs, long-run JKM prices, financing, and global
LNG supply.
